item.title: Websites That Work
item.description:
A lot of great local businesses still don’t have a website — or have one that’s slow, outdated or impossible to update. We build you a clean, fast site that looks great on a phone and does one job really well: get people to call, text or book.

What you get

  1. A mobile-first site with your services, service area, photos and reviews
  2. Click-to-call, click-to-text and simple quote or booking forms
  3. Fast hosting and a secure connection (the little lock in the browser)
  4. Set up so Google and AI assistants can understand what you do and where
  5. Your own domain and accounts — you own everything

Already have a site?

We can upgrade what you have instead of starting over: speed it up, fix the mobile layout, add online booking and make it easier to keep current.

item.title: Google & Local Search
item.description:
When someone searches “junk removal near me” or “house cleaners,” the businesses in the map results get most of the calls. We set up and tune your Google Business Profile and local listings so you’re one of them.

What we handle

  1. Create or claim your Google Business Profile and get it verified
  2. Categories, services, service area, hours and photos done right
  3. Consistent name, address and phone across Apple Maps, Bing, Yelp and other directories
  4. Regular posts and updates so your profile stays active
  5. Simple monthly check-ins on calls, direction requests and website clicks

item.title: AI Search Visibility
item.description:
More and more people skip the search results and just ask an AI assistant: “Who’s a good painter near me?” Those assistants pull from websites, listings and reviews. If your information is thin, messy or missing, you don’t get mentioned.

How we get you in the answer

  1. Clear, well-structured website content that spells out what you do, where and for whom
  2. Behind-the-scenes business data (schema) that machines can read
  3. Accurate, matching information across every listing AI tools draw from
  4. A steady flow of fresh reviews that describe your real work
  5. Periodic checks of how AI assistants describe your business — and fixes when they get it wrong

item.title: AI Front Desk
item.description:
Every missed call is a job that goes to someone else. We set up an AI assistant trained on your business that responds right away on your website chat, texts and missed calls — then hands the details to you.

What it can do

  1. Answer common questions: prices, service area, hours, what you do and don’t do
  2. Collect job details and photos so you can quote faster
  3. Book appointments straight into your calendar
  4. Text back missed calls within seconds
  5. Send you a clean summary of every conversation

You decide what it’s allowed to say, and you can step in any time.

item.title: AI Money Tracking
item.description:
Most small business owners know their money is “somewhere” between the register, the bank, Venmo and a stack of receipts. We set up a simple AI helper that does the logging for you.

How it works

  1. Snap a photo of a receipt, invoice or cash count — or just text a note like “sold $240 cash”
  2. The AI reads it and logs it as cash or card, income or expense
  3. Everything lands in one organized sheet you can actually understand
  4. Get a weekly cash-flow summary: what came in, what went out, what’s left
  5. Hand your bookkeeper or accountant clean records at tax time

No new software to learn — you use the phone you already carry.

item.title: Reviews & Reputation
item.description:
Reviews are what both people and AI assistants look at before they pick who to call. Most happy customers will leave one — they just need a simple, well-timed ask.

What we set up

  1. Automatic review requests by text or email after each job
  2. One-tap links that go straight to your Google review page
  3. Alerts when a new review comes in, so nothing slips by
  4. AI-drafted replies in your voice that you approve before posting
  5. Your best reviews featured on your website
